propositions.name: force_magnitude_and_direction
propositions.statement: The magnitude and direction of the force acting between two bodies can be ascertained as a definite physical quantity.
propositions.quote: The first step, therefore, in reducing these phenomena into scientific form, is to ascertain the magnitude and direction of the force acting between the bodies

propositions.name: relative_position_definite
propositions.statement: Two bodies have a definite relative position on which the force between them depends.
propositions.quote: the force acting between the two bodies is treated with reference only to the condition of the bodies and their relative position, and without any express consideration of the surrounding medium

propositions.name: body_at_rest_or_in_motion
propositions.statement: It is meaningful to say that something inside each body is either at rest or in motion as a matter of fact.
propositions.quote: it seems at first sight natural to explain the facts by assuming the existence of something either at rest or in motion in each body, constituting its electric or magnetic state

propositions.name: relative_velocity_of_particles
propositions.statement: Two particles have a well-defined relative velocity that a force can depend upon.
propositions.quote: he has found it necessary to assume that the force between two particles depends on their relative velocity, as well as on their distance

propositions.name: ethereal_medium_fills_space
propositions.statement: There is an ethereal medium filling space and permeating bodies, capable of being set in motion and of transmitting that motion.
propositions.quote: there is an ethereal medium filling space and permeating bodies, capable of being set in motion and of transmitting that motion from one part to another

propositions.name: ether_has_real_density
propositions.statement: The pervading medium has a small but real density comparable to that of gross matter.
propositions.quote: the existence of a pervading medium of small but real density, capable of being set in motion, and of transmitting motion from one part to another with great, but not infinite, velocity

propositions.name: finite_propagation_velocity
propositions.statement: Motion through the medium propagates with a great but finite velocity rather than instantaneously.
propositions.quote: transmitting motion from one part to another with great, but not infinite, velocity

propositions.name: communication_of_motion_occupies_time
propositions.statement: The communication of motion from one part of the medium to another is not instantaneous but occupies a definite time.
propositions.quote: these connections must be capable of a certain kind of elastic yielding, since the communication of motion is not instantaneous, but occupies time

propositions.name: transit_time_between_source_and_body
propositions.statement: There is a definite interval of time between when undulations leave a source and when they reach a receiving body.
propositions.quote: the energy communicated to the body in heating it must have formerly existed in the moving medium, for the undulations had left the source of heat some time before they reached the body

propositions.name: energy_split_during_transit
propositions.statement: During the transit of undulations half the energy is in the form of motion of the medium and half in the form of elastic resilience.
propositions.quote: during that time the energy must have been half in the form of motion of the medium and half in the form of elastic resilience

propositions.name: global_instant_of_total_energy
propositions.statement: At any given instant the amount of energy in the whole medium is a determinate quantity equally divided between motion and resilience.
propositions.quote: at any instant the amount of energy in the whole medium is equally divided, so that half is energy of motion, and half is elastic resilience

propositions.name: propagation_alternates_energy_forms
propositions.statement: The propagation of undulations consists in the continual transformation of one form of energy into the other alternately.
propositions.quote: The propagation of undulations consists in the continual transformation of one of these forms of energy into the other alternately

propositions.name: connected_parts_of_medium
propositions.statement: The parts of the medium are so connected that the motion of one part depends on the motion of the rest.
propositions.quote: the parts of this medium must be so connected that the motion of one part depends in some way on the motion of the rest

propositions.name: actual_and_potential_energy
propositions.statement: The medium can receive and store two kinds of energy, actual energy of motion of its parts and potential energy of elastic displacement.
propositions.quote: The medium is therefore capable of receiving and storing up two kinds of energy, namely, the

propositions.name: gross_matter_only_modifies_ether
propositions.statement: The presence of gross matter merely modifies in some way the motion of the ether without replacing it.
propositions.quote: we are obliged to admit that the undulations are those of an ethereal substance, and not of the gross matter, the presence of which merely modifies in some way the motion of the ether

propositions.name: rotation_axis_along_magnetic_force
propositions.statement: The motion of the ethereal medium where magnetic effects are observed is a rotation having the direction of the magnetic force as its axis.
propositions.quote: we have some reason to suppose that this motion is one of rotation, having the direction of the magnetic force as its axis

propositions.name: field_is_a_part_of_space
propositions.statement: The electromagnetic field is that part of space which contains and surrounds bodies in electric or magnetic conditions.
propositions.quote: The electromagnetic field is that part of space which contains and surrounds bodies in electric or magnetic conditions

propositions.name: motion_through_the_field
propositions.statement: A body has a definite motion through the electromagnetic field that gives rise to an electromotive force upon it.
propositions.quote: this, then, is a force acting on a body caused by its motion through the electromagnetic field, or by changes occurring in that field itself

propositions.name: body_has_two_extremities
propositions.statement: A body has two distinguishable extremities that can be oppositely electrified by an electromotive force.
propositions.quote: the two extremities of the body tend to become oppositely electrified, and an electric current tends to flow through the body

propositions.name: displacement_is_elastic_yielding
propositions.statement: Electric displacement is a kind of elastic yielding of the medium to the action of the electromotive force.
propositions.quote: another effect of electromotive force, namely, electric displacement, which according to our theory is a kind of elastic yielding to the action of the force

propositions.name: mechanism_obeys_dynamics
propositions.statement: The connected mechanism of the medium must be subject to the general laws of Dynamics.
propositions.quote: Such a mechanism must be subject to the general laws of Dynamics, and we ought to be able to work out all the consequences of its motion

propositions.name: lines_of_force_laid_down
propositions.statement: Systems of lines of magnetic force can be laid down in the field to indicate its magnetic properties in space.
propositions.quote: I then apply the phenomena of induction and attraction of currents to the exploration of the electromagnetic field, and the laying down systems of lines of magnetic force which indicate its magnetic properties

propositions.name: displacement_and_conduction_compounded
propositions.statement: Electric displacement and true conduction may be compounded together into a total current.
propositions.quote: (A) The relation between electric displacement, true conduction, and the total current, compounded of both

propositions.name: ratio_of_units_is_a_velocity
propositions.statement: The relation between the electrostatic and electromagnetic units of electricity is a velocity, namely the number of electrostatic units in one electromagnetic unit.
propositions.quote: the velocity of propagation is the velocity v , found from experiments such as those of Weber , which expresses the number of electrostatic units of electricity which are contained in one electromagnetic unit

propositions.name: only_transverse_disturbances_propagate
propositions.statement: In a non-conductive field the only magnetic disturbances that can be propagated are those transverse to the direction of propagation.
propositions.quote: the only disturbances which can be so propagated are those which are transverse to the direction of propagation

propositions.name: light_is_electromagnetic_disturbance
propositions.statement: The velocity v is so nearly that of light that light itself is an electromagnetic disturbance propagated through the field.
propositions.quote: This velocity is so nearly that of light, that it seems we have strong reason to conclude that light itself (including radiant heat, and other radiations if any) is an electromagnetic disturbance

propositions.name: elasticity_agrees_across_methods
propositions.statement: The elasticity of the medium calculated from rapid luminous vibrations agrees with that found by the slow process of electrical experiments.
propositions.quote: the agreement between the elasticity of the medium as calculated from the rapid alternations of luminous vibrations, and as found by the slow process of electrical experiments

propositions.name: refractive_index_squared_relation
propositions.statement: The square of the index of refraction is equal to the product of the specific dielectric capacity and the specific magnetic capacity.
propositions.quote: the square of the index of refraction is equal to the product of the specific dielectric capacity and the specific magnetic capacity

propositions.name: conductors_are_opaque
propositions.statement: Conducting media absorb such radiations rapidly and therefore are generally opaque.
propositions.quote: Conducting media are shown to absorb such radiations rapidly, and therefore to be generally opaque

propositions.name: equipotential_surfaces_at_right_angles
propositions.statement: Equipotential magnetic surfaces of the field cut the lines of magnetic force at right angles.
propositions.quote: By exploring the same field with a magnet, I show the distribution of its equipotential magnetic surfaces, cutting the lines of force at right angles

propositions.name: field_property_independent_of_medium
propositions.statement: The properties of the magnetic field are not so much altered by substituting one medium or a vacuum that dense media do more than modify the motion of the ether.
propositions.quote: the properties of the magnetic field are not so much altered by the substitution of one medium for another, or for a vacuum, as to allow us to suppose that the dense medium does anything more than merely modify the motion of the ether

propositions.name: energy_transformation_irreversible_in_conductor
propositions.statement: In a conducting circuit electromotive force produces a current whose meeting with resistance transforms electrical energy into heat irreversibly.
propositions.quote: it produces a current, which, as it meets with resistance, occasions a continual transformation of electrical energy into heat, which is incapable of being restored again to the form of electrical energy by an reversal of the process
